concerns.text: FR-010 mandates stratification by confinement mode (L/H) but lacks a minimum N per stratum. With total N=5-10, stratification risks N<3 per group, making correlation mathematically undefined (df=0 or 1). The requirement is unverifiable as written because the system cannot fulfill the 'output separate coefficients' clause if the data structure prevents calculation. A specific threshold (e.g., 'if N_stratum >= 3') must be added to make the success condition measurable.

FR-007 requires aborting if 'any single operation exceeds these bounds' but does not define the bounds. The text references 'these bounds' without specifying the time limit (e.g., 6 hours, 10 minutes). Without a quantitative threshold, the requirement is untestable.

SC-003 states execution time is 'measured against the CI runner time limit' but does not specify the limit value. Success criteria must state the specific threshold (e.g., '≤ 6 hours') to be measurable.
SC-004 states memory footprint is 'measured against the available RAM limit' but does not specify the limit value (e.g., '≤ 2GB'). Without a specific number, the criterion is unmeasurable.
